summary: Frontend-only verification of the SHOP seller portal URL-identity fix (Fixing_Prompt v13). All 8 acceptance criteria PASS on preview URL https://baked-platform.preview.emergentagent.com using demo-delta-supplier@test.example / Supplier1234!. SHOP post-login now lands on /shopbaked/delta/portal/dashboard (not /martbaked/…). MART regression intact. Sidebar NavLinks and 'Back to Sellers Home' link honour the current URL prefix. 401 interceptor & wrong-slug guard preserve the /shopbaked/ prefix. Legacy /martbaked/sellers/portal/dashboard still redirects to /martbaked/delta/portal/dashboard.

verified_flows.sidebar_prefix_on_shop: PASS — all 10 portal-nav-* hrefs start with /shopbaked/delta/portal/ (dashboard, profile, catalogue, shop, shop-orders, orders, invoices, product-requests, documents, supply-locations)
verified_flows.sidebar_prefix_on_mart: PASS — all 10 portal-nav-* hrefs start with /martbaked/delta/portal/

critical_code_review_comments: SellerPortalApp.jsx:225-226 has a duplicated `if (loading) return <LoadingScreen />;` line — harmless but dead code; consider removing for cleanliness.

PortalShell logout() hard-codes navigate('/martbaked/sellers') — should honour portalPrefix so SHOP users logging out from /shopbaked/… land on /shopbaked/sellers instead of MART landing. Not in the current review scope but consistent with the URL-identity theme of this fix.

SellerApp.jsx SellerLogin 'not_active' error block still hard-codes /martbaked/sellers/application-status and /martbaked/sellers/activate links even when the login was hit at /shopbaked/sellers/login — same prefix leak class, easy follow-up.

SellerActivate submit() also hard-codes navigate(`/martbaked/${slug}/portal/dashboard`) — SHOP-approved sellers activating via a /shopbaked link would still land on /martbaked. Recommend applying the same window.location.pathname.startsWith('/shopbaked') check used in SellerLogin.

NAV array in SellerPortalApp.jsx renders both 'SHOPbakēd' and 'SHOP Orders' tiles unconditionally regardless of the `module` prop — SHOP-only tiles will show up in the MART sidebar. Consider gating by module or by supplier.modules[]. Out of scope for this URL fix but visible in the screenshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SHOP URL identity fix is fully verified. If follow-up work addresses the logout/activate/not-active-links prefix leak or SHOP-only nav gating (see critical_code_review_comments), re-run the same acceptance flow to make sure the working paths don't regress. Preview URL and credentials unchanged.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix is working as intended. SellerPortalApp now accepts a `module` prop, derives portalPrefix accordingly, threads it to PortalShell for NavLink hrefs, and the 401 interceptor and post-login redirect both branch on window.location.pathname.startsWith('/shopbaked').
